title: OptoLum amended complaint: Philips L Prize bulb sales
lineage: OptoLum’s 2017 amended civil complaint, reproduced as an exhibit in a patent proceeding, alleges the L Prize bulb was sold online in February 2012 and in retail stores on 22 April 2012. This is a litigant’s historical account, not a judicial finding.
